rubric: Evaluate the contract from the public request, explicit issue-time owner decisions, and contemporaneous observable behavior. Require each material boundary and supported externally observable outcome, including applicable error behavior and preservation of compatible behavior. Treat code structure, algorithms, predicates broader than the supported input, internal representations, helper behavior, messages, documentation edits, refactors, and test data, form, or placement as optional unless the evidence expressly requires them. Later patches and tests may confirm the defect, causal mechanism, expected outcome, analogous coverage, or non-regression, but cannot retroactively require their particular implementation, private assertions, fixture choices, or unapproved scope. Penalize omitted material decisions, unsupported broadening, and compatibility regressions; accept any implementation that satisfies the evidence-supported observable contract.
